title: artifact
description: Anything manufactured from snapshots or other artifacts. Geometry, normalised triples, feature tensors, indexes, checkpoints, calibration products -- all of them need parents, a generator, parameters, validation and a licence lineage, so all of them are this object and a typed artifact adds fields rather than starting over.

parents.description: Typed refs. Every one of them, including the ones that only supplied a parameter -- an artifact whose parent list is incomplete produces a licence closure that is wrong in the permissive direction.

derivation.description: measured | derived | simulated | ... Derived can never become measured.

license_lineage.description: Computed, never authored: the closure over the parents' licences, taking the most restrictive term on each axis.
